summary: Describes how an IKEv2 server and a Diameter server can interact using shared keys. IKEv2 sets up IPsec security associations and supports several authentication methods, and this document covers the case where a shared key is used. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Two guards share a secret password so one can check visitors for the other. This memo says how VPN servers and Diameter servers use that shared secret.

questions: how does ikev2 use diameter with shared keys
